summary: Admit reserved notice facts through graph-designated runtime and immutable authenticated source lineage.

replay.detail: Custom folding checks current runtime/source authority and registration integrity, not historical admission. Mandatory source and creation dependencies survive pending and invalid rows. Registry prefix expansion precedes consumer invalidation, so registration repair and missing manifest documents also revalidate linked rows. Revalidation follows the designated agent and its owning/ancestor chain. No-work notice finalization is SQL-free; touched authority or custom state still revalidates, including comparison of the runtime resolver's actual availability outcome, so identity conflicts and pending/invalid lifecycle records cannot leave cached notices ready. The preparation fence accepts only exact native notifier definitions, shared with their installer; altered triggers and unknown temporary objects remain ineligible. Unchanged outcomes and unrelated mission/agent mutations do not refold notices. This is a finalization contract, not a checked performance result. Historical admission cuts, revocation and partition ordering remain B2 requirements before rollout.

schema.detail: One live agent may declare the bare notice-runtime graph role. A graph apply leaving a second live holder is refused.

rules.detail: Existing graph publishers may designate the runtime. Only that authenticated actor writes snapshots; only the independently resolved source recipient, a person, writes controls. Payload actor fields never confer authority. Immutable source lineage authenticates the stored source creation claim and reviewed manifest digest, not external git commits named in input.source.

compatibility.detail: Generic raw notice reads remain denied. Generic seat-summary visibility and reduction share one pinned read snapshot and cut; the incarnation reduction independently excludes reserved fields and source identities. Managed-session owner visibility and lookup share one read snapshot and uncached routing identities from its pinned connection, never a shared map rebuilt by a concurrent repair at the same claim cut. Native recipient-authorized views and typed controls are not exposed by this slice. Mixed-version or dependency gaps cannot fall back to generic notice reads on upgraded members.

manual.detail: Designate exactly one notice runtime and register the reviewed manifests before local notice fact admission.

recovery.detail: Restore a unique live designation and reviewed registration dependencies. Invalid declaration JSON is not a designation and cannot break unrelated projection repairs. Runtime handover provenance, partition conflict admission, revocation and replay ordering require B2 before publication rollout.
